newsitem.title: USA: FSA qualifies eight issues for bond insurance.
newsitem.headline: FSA qualifies eight issues for bond insurance.

text.p: Financial Security Assurance said it qualified for insurance eight bond issues slated for competitive sale on Tuesday.
--Cold Spring SD, Calif., $1.4 million of general obligation (GO) bonds.
--Petaluma City Elementary School, Calif., $4.5 million of GO bonds.
--Petaluma City High School, Calif., $10.7 million of GO bonds.
--Novi Building Authority, Mich., $8.5 million of building bonds.
--DeRuyter CSD, N.Y., $4.2 million of school district bonds.
--Kenmore-Tonawanda SD, N.Y., $7.9 million of school district bonds.
--Fox Chapel Authority, Pa., $10.6 million of revenue bonds under direct purchase.
--Harker Heights, Texas, $4.9 million of certificates of obligation.
